name: dvp_rx
semantics: Unbackpressured parallel camera byte receiver, gray8/RGB565, synchronous FIFO and strict frame/line validation
limitations: Single shared pixel clock; no CDC or sensor electrical interface
Finite FIFO capacity; host stalls or CE-off can overflow
Pixels provisional until successful DONE; discard whole frame on error
One armed frame per START; initial VSYNC boundary lock required
